verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI features generate insights and suggestions from the user's own code and PR data inside the product. AI reviews flag issues and suggest fixes on every PR, and Graphite Chat summarizes changes, highlights potential issues and diagnoses failing CI checks using CI context. Suggested fixes can be applied in one click from the review page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of how useful the AI suggestions are, and any evidence that the Insights productivity analytics are AI-generated rather than plain metrics.
